title: Playboy June 1981 Playmate of the Year Terri Welles Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Complete w/ centerfold. Front cover has scattered white speckle/ink-loss spots across the image (see photo 1). Back cover clean. Spine intact.
description:
Playboy magazine, June 1981 - Playmate of the Year issue, original $2.50 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Playmate of the Year: Terri Welles. Centerfold: Cathy Larmouth.

Cover features: Playmate of the Year Terri Welles, a new woman for the eighties; Playboy Interview with baseball superstar Steve Garvey; The Road to Executive Power by Michael Korda; the eye-popping girls of the new James Bond film plus Bond-contest discovery Robbin Young; Jack Lemmon tells why Hollywood can't make love stories.

Back cover: Michelob beer ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
